description: Check whether IBANs are structurally valid - length, country, checksum - without looking up the bank behind them. Use this when the question is only 'is this typed correctly'; use analyze_iban when the answer needs to name a bank. Costs one validation from the caller's monthly allowance.

ibans.description: The IBANs to look up, as written. Spaces and lower case are fine. Up to 50 per call.

name: validate_iban
title: Check an IBAN is well formed
